cmux-nightly-<lease>-<job>.served_by: one ephemeral GCP VM per job, provisioned for that lease by fleet-reconciler-gha-runners.yml: its JIT listener carries only this unique label, so no other queued job can take it. The label stands for the run-time name cmux-nightly-<24-hex lease id>-<job>; no runs-on spells it, it reaches a job only through a decide.early_*_runner output.
cmux-nightly-<lease>-<job>.note: Emitted only for a status fleet receipt, which the controller grants only when the provisioner's ready receipt names exactly these listeners, started before the lease expired; nightly_linux_admission.py validate() refuses any other runner name. The listener is already online and bound to its one job when the job is queued. If it is lost after that, nothing re-routes the queued job; a re-run's early_attempt guard drops the output and the job takes cmux-fleet-linux-x64.
